title: Move case study details into modal dialogs
context: Replace inline project detail lists with click-driven modal dialogs so tiles show image/title/description only on load, and full details appear on demand with minimal grow animation.

tasks.title: Implement modal-based case study details
acceptance_criteria: Projects tiles initially show only image, title, and description; inline detail lists are not rendered in the grid.
Each tile has a button that opens a modal for that project.
Modal displays full case study details list for the selected project and can be dismissed with close button, overlay click, and Escape key.
Modal includes a minimal grow-in animation when opened.
Projects section tests are updated to verify new tile and modal behavior.
Project verification command passes after the change.
